name: @tetherto/mdk-plugin-full-site-mcp
description: Full-site example MCP tools: query and control workers/devices via the MDK protocol client over the RPC listener.

tools.description: Get current status of all workers and device counts
Get the capabilities (command schema) for a device
Pull telemetry metrics for a device
Pull current state snapshot for a device
Get the supported power modes for a device
Send a command to a device (e.g. reboot, set_power_mode)
